title: marrubium multibracteatum subsp. ayachicum
intro: Marrubium multibracteatum subsp. ayachicum, commonly known as the Ayachicum horehound, is a subspecies of the Marrubium multibracteatum plant, which is a type of perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Ayachicum horehound include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Marrubium multibracteatum subsp. ayachicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
